iso_image.description: Path to the ISO, BIN, NRG, IMG, or MDF image to mount (required).

mount_point.description: Mount point directory (required). Created if -p is used.

iocharset.description: Character set for Joliet filesystems (e.g., iso8859-1, UTF-8). Must be supported by iconv.

create_mount_point.description: If true, create mount point if missing and remove on exit (implied by -p).

foreground.description: If true, run in foreground (no daemonization). Implied by debug.

debug.description: If true, run in foreground with debug output (implies foreground).
